review.basis: Compared the complete pinned Hebrew and Greek verses in their chapter sequence, including opening/closing clauses, names, genealogy members, numerical differences and adjacent boundaries. Extent correspondence does not assert identical wording.

relations.note: The short genealogy entry names Dan and Hushim. Inspected between the Rachel and Naphtali entries; identical Hebrew letters and the same local boundaries. Individually reviewed because the automatic minimum-length safeguard deliberately leaves short matches unresolved.
